prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: low-speed head-on collision in Baytown, Texas. Injury: shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1399; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was driving home on a weekday afternoon when the car in front of me stopped suddenly, and I was unable to avoid a low-speed head-on collision with the vehicle coming toward me in my lane. Both cars were moving slowly when they met, and the impact was not severe, but my body was thrown forward against the seatbelt and I felt an immediate pain in my right shoulder. I have described the events the same way to the officer at the scene, to the adjuster, and to my doctor, and I have nothing to add or change. I am the named driver on this policy and was the person operating the vehicle at the time. I sought medical attention the same day, and I am still receiving treatment for the shoulder. I am providing this account so the claim can be assessed accurately.
